sampling: Voluntary consenting adults, stratified by novice/experienced self-report; convenience sample, no population inference.
assignment: Balanced AB/BA order per task, opaque IDs, matching device and five-minute cap per version; two-minute neutral break. Retain order as analysis factor.
blinding: Coordinator retains private arm key. Raters receive only opaque packet ID and playable build. Log any inferred/revealed condition and report it.

scale.anchors: 1 = very low, 7 = very high for the named dimension. Difficulty/repetition are descriptive, not inherently better higher.

consent: Explain purpose, optional participation, data retained, and ability to stop. No payment, recruitment messages, or personal data collection without user authorization.
privacy: Anonymous IDs only in the package; no contact, health, age detail, or credentials. Eligibility adult yes/no handled by the authorized coordinator.
analysis: Report each dimension separately, sample size, paired differences and order effects. Keep exploratory label. Missing participants or missing builds means NOT_RUN, never synthetic ratings.
stopping: Stop an individual session on request or five-minute cap; stop the study only at preregistered target or documented operational blocker.
